metadata.analysis_method: Manual analysis based on domain logic and workflow understanding
key_insights: Authentication APIs (find_user_id_*) are required entry points for nearly all workflows
get_user_details and get_order_details are central hubs that provide IDs needed by many other APIs
Order modification/cancellation APIs require checking order status first via get_order_details
Product APIs are needed when modifying or exchanging items to find valid variant item_ids
calculate and transfer_to_human_agents are standalone utilities with no dependencies
